cover_headline: Bengaluru-Born Astronomer Ramya Anche to Lead NASA's $20 Million PUFFINS Mission
facts: NASA has awarded $20 million to a University of Arizona team to build PUFFINS, a small space telescope that will study interstellar dust
PUFFINS will use a 10-inch telescope in low-Earth orbit to observe about 70 stars, with a target launch in 2030
Ramya Anche, an assistant research professor at Steward Observatory, led the winning NASA proposal while still a postdoctoral researcher

end.headline: Bengaluru-Born Astronomer Ramya Anche to Lead NASA's $20 Million PUFFINS Mission
end.line: PUFFINS will study interstellar dust from about 70 stars ahead of a 2030 launch.

quote.text: PUFFINS will change how we understand the dust between stars.
quote.speaker: Ramya Anche
